cells.old: - The word 'XML' is used here because Res. 227 art. 1.3.10.1 lists Format 2276 among the formats with published technical specifications, and the exogena service accepts XML. The resolution itself prescribes no XSD: the element names, ordering and lengths are fixed by the technical specifications of Format 2276 version 4, so every element path in this specification is a logical name marked DERIVED, mapped to the element names of the published technical specifications. The physical file is an XML document in ISO-8859-1 encoding named Dmuisca_ccmmmmmvvaaaacccccccc.xml (cc = 01 insertion / 02 replacement, mmmmm = format 02276, vv = version 04, aaaa = year of sending (four digits; Anexo T3.45), cccccccc = consecutive file number), with at most 5,000 records per file.
cells.new: - The word 'XML' is used here because Res. 227 art. 1.3.10.1 lists Format 2276 among the formats with published technical specifications, and the exogena service accepts XML. The resolution itself does not print the XSD, but the official technical specification does: Annex 45 of Res. DIAN 000162 of 2023 (Format 2276 version 4, section 4 'Esquema XSD'), which Res. 227 art. 1.3.10.1 lists as T3.45. Its root element is mas, the header is Cab and each beneficiary is one rentra element; the numerals travel as the rentra attributes named in column H of the Formato 2276 Spec sheet. The physical file is an XML document in ISO-8859-1 encoding named Dmuisca_ccmmmmmvvaaaacccccccc.xml (cc = 01 insertion / 02 replacement, mmmmm = format 02276, vv = version 04, aaaa = year of sending (four digits; Anexo T3.45), cccccccc = consecutive file number), with at most 5,000 records per file.

cells.old: The technical specifications annex of Format 2276 version 4 fixes the XML ELEMENT NAMES, the field ordering and the column lengths; it is a SEPARATE document from Res. 227, which prescribes WHAT to report, not how the file is shaped. Every element path in this specification is therefore a logical name marked DERIVED. The productive layout is configured from the published technical specifications.
cells.new: The technical specifications annex of Format 2276 version 4 fixes the XML ELEMENT NAMES, the field ordering and the column lengths; it is a SEPARATE document from Res. 227, which prescribes WHAT to report, not how the file is shaped. The XML names used in this specification are those of the official XSD (Annex 45 of Res. DIAN 000162 of 2023, section 4): root mas, header Cab, one rentra element per beneficiary, numerals as rentra attributes (column H of the Formato 2276 Spec sheet). The unique key of a record is entinfo + tdocb + nitb + identfc + tdocpcc + nitpcc, which must not repeat among the records sent for the same year or period. The productive layout is configured from the published technical specifications.

cells.old: USEFUL CONTROL: for a pure non-resident record, N29 is almost exactly 20% of N22. Here 31,488,000 / 157,440,000 = 20.00%. A resident's ratio is 4.7%. The format has no tax-residence field (the country in numeral 4 is the country of the beneficiary's address), so this arithmetic is the only signal - and a mid-year residence change breaks it, which is itself worth flagging before the control fires.
